{{Quote|We could find ourselves facing anything from a few dozen to several thousand of those TIE defenders; the records captured during the Spirana operation indicate that there are still over ten thousand verified-production defenders unaccounted for.|[[Thavish]], in a New Republic military meeting|<ref name="Mindor">''[[Luke Skywalker and the Shadows of Mindor]]''</ref>}}
'''Spirana''' was an astronomical object in the [[Inner Rim/Legends|Inner Rim]] Territories. It was situated along the [[Corellian Run/Legends|Corellian Run]].

==History==
In [[5 ABY/Legends|5 ABY]], the [[New Republic/Legends|New Republic]] conducted an [[Battle of Spirana|operation]] at Spirana. It was discovered that there were still about ten thousand [[TIE/d "Defender" Multi-Role Starfighter/Legends|TIE Defenders]] unaccounted for after major [[Galactic Empire/Legends|Imperial]] [[Battle of Endor/Legends|defeat]].<ref name="Mindor" />
